claims.evidence: Witness report shows only the machine wrapped in plastic; no location/use history is visible.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions, delivering...
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show performance tests, specs, or any functional demonstration.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may not print/copy correctly (faults hidden under plastic wrap).
risks.proof: A short video/clip of powering on and completing a test print/copy (showing no error codes).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested until a successful power-on + test print/copy is shown.

risks.risk: Drum/toner condition may be poor, leading to low-quality prints or imminent replacement.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the toner/drum area (or a print sample showing image quality) taken after removing plastic.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case consumables condition (assume toner/drum may need replacement soon).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (trays, output tray, power cable, manuals) not visible while wrapped.
risks.proof: Photo of the full contents laid out (all trays/covers/cables) plus a checklist showing each included item.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete package and deduct for likely missing accessories.

risks.risk: Physical damage (dents/cracks/missing components) may be concealed by plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Unwrapped 360° photos and close-ups of corners/edges/hinges showing no cracks or dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged until unwrapped inspection confirms condition.

risks.risk: Connectivity/ports may be non-functional (USB/LAN/Wi‑Fi) affecting scanning/printing over network.
risks.proof: A clip showing the machine connected to LAN (or USB) and successfully printing/scanning from a phone/laptop.
risks.if_unproven: Price as limited functionality (assume only basic local use, or treat network features as unreliable).

risks.risk: High usage/page count or error history could indicate end-of-life components.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine’s usage/counter page and any error/status screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case wear (assume high usage) until counter/status is provided.

proof_requests: Power-on video and a completed test print/copy (showing no error codes).
Close-up photos of toner/drum area after removing plastic, or a clear print sample showing quality.
Photos of all included accessories laid out (power cable, trays, output tray, manuals, etc.).
Unwrapped 360° inspection photos (corners, edges, hinges) to confirm no hidden damage.
A clip demonstrating connectivity: LAN/USB connection and successful print (and scan if claimed).
Photo of the usage/counter page and any status/error screen.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a SHARP AR-M207 copier/printer, so it can be priced at its worst-case as an untested, plastic-wrapped unit. Seller statements about London use and performance are not verifiable from the report.
